intro.zh:
你好，我是 Hayden。
把想法做成作品，
也把过程写下来。
intro.en:
Hello, I’m Hayden.
I build things,
and write along the way.

description.zh: 在代码、设计和日常之间，探索更有温度的数字体验。这里收藏我的作品、开发记录，以及对赛车和生活的热爱。
description.en: Exploring thoughtful digital experiences through code, design and everyday life. A home for my projects, notes and love of motorsport.

bio.zh: 我是一名热爱技术的高中生，也是一名独立开发者。我相信好的代码不仅要能运行，更要优雅、可维护。
bio.en: I’m a high school student and independent developer who loves technology. I believe good code should work well and remain clear and maintainable.

bio.zh: 课余时间，我喜欢把想法变成现实。从原生应用到 Web 游戏，动手做项目是我学习和表达创意的方式。
bio.en: In my spare time, I turn ideas into working projects. From native apps to web games, building is how I learn and express my creativity.

bio.zh: 离开编辑器，我也会关注新的技术、画产品原型，或与 DHGT 的朋友们聊聊赛车。期待做出真正有价值的产品。
bio.en: Away from the editor, I explore new technology, sketch prototypes and share motorsport with friends at DHGT. I hope to build things that matter.
